name: io.github.cachly-dev/mcp-server
title: cachly — memory for coding agents
description: Memory for coding agents: stores every fix and finds it again when the problem returns. EU-hosted.

environmentVariables.name: CACHLY_JWT
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key (starts with cky_). Leave it empty and cachly sets up a trial Brain on first use.

environmentVariables.name: CACHLY_BRAIN_INSTANCE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Brain id. Leave it empty to use the Brain saved by setup.

environmentVariables.name: CACHLY_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to turn off usage pings.
